storyTitle: And Every Number Represents a Story
storyLede: Behind every event, chapter, and member of our network is an opportunity for a conversation, introduction, or shared experience that has helped Harvard alumni in tech move forward.
storyPullQuote: Sometimes, the most meaningful opportunities begin with a single conversation.
storyBody: An introduction to someone who has been where you are going. A roundtable where a new idea becomes sharper. A community gathering that turns a shared interest into a lasting collaboration.
A moment of encouragement that reminds someone they are not building alone.
Harvard Alumni in Tech exists to create more of these moments, the kind that help alumni find one another, support one another, and move further together.
Across cities, industries, and career stages, our network brings together founders, builders, operators, students, investors, and innovators who believe in the power of community.
Because when exceptional people are connected to the right community, one conversation can open a door, one relationship can shape a path, and one network can help create what comes next.

whyBody.title: Harvard in Tech is at an important turning point
paragraphs: We are a volunteer-led alumni community that has grown into a global network of founders, technologists, operators, investors, and professionals who are building, mentoring, launching, and opening doors for one another.
Together, we can create an impact that lasts beyond any one event, message, or moment.

To meet this moment, we need the infrastructure to support the momentum we are already seeing. That means creating more consistent programming, expanding access to meaningful connections, supporting volunteers with stronger tools and resources, growing our digital presence, and building the operational foundation needed to serve our community at a higher level.

whyBody.title: This is why your support matters
paragraphs: It gives Harvard in Tech the ability to plan ahead, invest more intentionally, and create a stronger, more sustainable alumni-powered ecosystem.
Now is the time to move from informal support to intentional investment.
Because the future of this network will not be built by chance. It will be built by alumni who believe in what this community can become and choose to help power it forward every month.

pillars.title: Create Meaningful Connections
pillars.body: Support events, roundtables, and gatherings that help alumni build valuable relationships and discover new opportunities.

pillars.title: Expand Access to Knowledge
pillars.body: Power practical content, mentorship, and conversations that help founders, innovators, and tech professionals grow.

pillars.title: Strengthen the Network
pillars.body: Build the infrastructure, volunteer resources, and city chapters needed to serve more alumni and sustain the community.

ctaBody: Join the alumni choosing to move from informal support to intentional investment, every month.
